Add the on-chain group buy (Plan 4): program, launcher, dashboard deposits

- onchain/group-buy: native Solana program. Investors deposit into their
  own escrow PDA and can withdraw until the buy; execute_buy sweeps every
  escrow, pays the fee to the fixed buyback address and makes one pump.fun
  buy_exact_quote_in_v2 from a vault PDA, only on a fresh curve with pinned
  mint/buyer accounts and a slippage floor; settle hands out exact pro-rata
  tokens and unspent SOL; refunds after cancel or deadline need no investor
  signature. Terms are fixed at init; there is no admin key.
- onchain/mock-pump + onchain/tests: LiteSVM end-to-end tests and golden
  vectors that keep the JS client in sync with the Rust layout
- onchain/client/launcher.js: init, lookup table, Jito create+buy bundle,
  settle, refund, cancel, close; every landed tx is logged on the chain
- src/launch/onchain.js: dependency-free PDAs and instruction encoding
- backend: "launch onchain", "launch tx", "buyback" record commands;
  dashboard shows on-chain details once init lands
- index.html: deposit/withdraw for committed investors; [hidden] fix;
  countdown shows Closed after close
- plans: Plan 4 approved and implemented (escrow deposits replace
  durable-nonce pre-signing); go-live steps in follow_up_4.md
